status: BRIEF ONLY - no sprite has been authored

concept.hook: Very narrow needle-like leaves on a slender stem, with dense whitish flower clusters at the branch tips.
concept.organ: small dense whitish clusters at the tips of a fine, many-branched stem; the narrow leaves are the arms
concept.gesture: the narrow leaves bristle outward like pine needles and stand at attention, then relax flat
concept.avoid: Mentha's 're-renders itself in ice' gesture, and any scent or 'minty' effect; draw nothing that implies aroma or use

palette_rules: Every species owns a hue; leaves never within 34deg of the flower; midtone saturation capped; the five FACE_PALETTE colours are shared and never recoloured.

stages.sprout: vegetative only - leaves and NO flower structure of any kind
stages.growing: in BUD - closed flower, a different organ from the open one
stages.flowering: the authored adult portrait; frame 0 is the resting pose and ONE connected piece

build: write scripts/sprite_sources/<snake_case_id>.py (authored module with a named gesture)
regenerates public/cards/animated/* and src/data/sprites.json - do this ONLY when the card is being promoted
rules: a portrait, never an identification aid
nothing may imply a medicinal effect
no invented botany: only what the card and the plant support
part placement is measured from the assembled art, never inferred from parameters
